bagPolicy.summary: Official venue guidance applies a clear-bag policy with a stated maximum size of 12 x 12 x 6 inches.
allowed: Clear bag up to 12 x 12 x 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; recommends or requires advance purchase where offered.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the rideshare pickup and drop-off area at Hutchins Street and Walker Street.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The stadium is cashless and accepts credit cards, debit cards, gift cards, and mobile pay. Outside food and beverages aren't allowed, but food needed for a dietary, religious, or medical reason can be approved in advance by Guest Services at guestservices@houstondynamo.com.

accessibility.summary: Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available at any entry point; ask the nearest Guest Services Representative when you arrive. Escorts go between the entry gates and your seat, but staff and the wheelchair won't stay with you during the event.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed at any ticketed event.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information; will call is addressed on the linked page.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For Houston Dynamo FC matches, all gates open 90 minutes before match start, and for Houston Dash matches, 60 minutes before. Concerts can differ, so check your event page or email guestservices@houstondynamo.com before the event.
